messages:
sam: Quick ask  We need a one-paragraph commercial-ready "readiness rubric" for pilots that combine tenant isolation + multi-region routing. Sales wants a single block they can paste in emails to explain what we validate before enabling features. Can someone produce an AM-friendly draft? @jess

jess: I'll take it. Keep tone non-technical. Suggest structure: 5 bullets (Preconditions, What we test, Safety gates, What to expect post-enable, Who signs off).

raja: Ops additions: include the default soft-spill %, required burst buffer, KV evacuation objective, and the emergency flow (disable routing -> warm local variant). Also call out expected maintenance windows for migration.

sam: Draft below  short bullets, clear customer language.

sam: ```text
Pilot onboarding readiness rubric (for AMs)

1) Preconditions: crypto key (KMS) connected, residency preferences declared, SLA tier selected.
2) What we test: 1-hour live smoke using your prompts + 10-minute simulated cross-region spill (default 5% traffic).
3) Safety gates: correctness regressions <5% vs baseline; p50 latency target met for chosen SLA; KV-evac P95 <30s; token-cost within agreed tolerance.
4) Ops controls: cost-cap in place, autoscale limits configured, and an immediate-disable route available to stop cross-region routing.
5) Post-enable expectations: 48h burn-in monitoring, a follow-up readiness report, and a scheduled migration window if we need to move traffic.
6) Signoffs required: product, ops, and legal for regulated residency customers.

Notes: cross-region fallback is opt-in for regulated jurisdictions; dedicated lanes require a capacity commitment and separate pricing.
```

jess: Sales phrasing tweak: replace "immediate-disable route" with "one-click disable" in the customer-facing note. Add a short line: "We’ll run a dry-run with you prior to enablement."

raja: Internal runbook snippet (ops): "on alert -> flip routing flag -> pause new sessions -> drain KV windows -> spin up local variant -> sanity checks -> re-enable". Recommend we validate warm-cache performance during the dry-run.

legal-bot: Note: For EU/CA customers, cross-region fallback requires explicit contract language. We'll provide a short clause for AMs to attach.

sam: Thanks — I'll merge this into the pilot onboarding page and produce a one-line email blurb for AMs: "We validate keys, residency, 1h smoke, 10m spill test, safety gates, and a 48h burn-in; signed-off by product/ops/legal."

ops-bot: Created doc draft: infra/pilot-readiness/commercial-rubric.md (PR 5)

jess: Great. If no objections, I'll finalize and post to the pilot-docs repo by EOD. :white_check_mark:
